```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  fig.align = "center",
  fig.width = 10,
  fig.height = 6.8,
  dpi = 180
)

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

set.seed(1031)
```

## 设计说明

本例使用模拟数据复现带显著性标注的分裂小提琴图。每个细胞类型中，左半侧表示 Active compartment，右半侧表示 Repressive compartment；白色竖线和圆点分别表示四分位区间和中位数；上方括号展示两组比较结果。

## 模拟数据

```{r simulate-data}
cell_types <- c("Exc", "Inh", "Ast", "Oli", "OPC", "Mic/Immune", "Vasc")
compartments <- c("Active", "Repressive")
n_per_group <- 220

cell_offsets <- c(
  Exc = 0.000,
  Inh = 0.004,
  Ast = 0.002,
  Oli = 0.006,
  OPC = 0.003,
  `Mic/Immune` = -0.002,
  Vasc = 0.004
)

violin_data <- bind_rows(lapply(seq_along(cell_types), function(i) {
  cell_type <- cell_types[i]
  offset <- unname(cell_offsets[cell_type])

  bind_rows(
    data.frame(
      cell_type = cell_type,
      compartment = "Active",
      at_content = rnorm(n_per_group, mean = 0.575 + offset, sd = 0.032)
    ),
    data.frame(
      cell_type = cell_type,
      compartment = "Repressive",
      at_content = rnorm(n_per_group, mean = 0.624 + offset / 2, sd = 0.024)
    )
  )
})) |>
  mutate(
    at_content = pmin(pmax(at_content, 0.38), 0.685),
    cell_type = factor(cell_type, levels = cell_types),
    compartment = factor(compartment, levels = compartments),
    x = as.integer(cell_type),
    split_group = 2 * (x - 1) + as.integer(compartment)
  )

write.csv(
  violin_data |>
    select(cell_type, compartment, at_content),
  "synthetic_at_content.csv",
  row.names = FALSE,
  fileEncoding = "UTF-8"
)

head(violin_data)
```

## 自定义左右分裂小提琴几何对象

```{r split-violin-geom}
GeomSplitViolin <- ggproto(
  "GeomSplitViolin",
  GeomViolin,
  draw_group = function(self, data, panel_scales, coord) {
    data <- transform(
      data,
      xminv = x - violinwidth * (x - xmin),
      xmaxv = x + violinwidth * (xmax - x)
    )

    group_number <- data$group[1]
    new_data <- transform(
      data,
      x = if (group_number %% 2 == 1) xminv else xmaxv
    )

    if (group_number %% 2 == 1) {
      new_data <- new_data[order(new_data$y), ]
    } else {
      new_data <- new_data[order(-new_data$y), ]
    }

    new_data <- rbind(
      new_data[1, ],
      new_data,
      new_data[nrow(new_data), ],
      new_data[1, ]
    )
    new_data[c(1, nrow(new_data) - 1, nrow(new_data)), "x"] <- round(data$x[1])

    GeomPolygon$draw_panel(new_data, panel_scales, coord)
  }
)

geom_split_violin <- function(mapping = NULL, data = NULL,
                              stat = "ydensity", position = "identity",
                              ..., trim = TRUE, scale = "area",
                              na.rm = FALSE, show.legend = NA,
                              inherit.aes = TRUE) {
  layer(
    data = data,
    mapping = mapping,
    stat = stat,
    geom = GeomSplitViolin,
    position = position,
    show.legend = show.legend,
    inherit.aes = inherit.aes,
    params = list(
      trim = trim,
      scale = scale,
      na.rm = na.rm,
      ...
    )
  )
}
```

## 统计汇总和显著性检验

```{r statistics}
summary_data <- violin_data |>
  group_by(cell_type, compartment) |>
  summarise(
    median = median(at_content),
    q25 = quantile(at_content, 0.25),
    q75 = quantile(at_content, 0.75),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    x = as.integer(cell_type) + if_else(compartment == "Active", -0.12, 0.12)
  )

significance_data <- bind_rows(lapply(seq_along(cell_types), function(i) {
  cell_type <- cell_types[i]
  cell_subset <- violin_data |>
    filter(as.character(.data$cell_type) == cell_type)

  p_value <- t.test(
    at_content ~ compartment,
    data = cell_subset
  )$p.value

  data.frame(
    cell_type = cell_type,
    x = i,
    p_value = p_value,
    label = ifelse(p_value < 2.2e-16, "< 2.2e−16", format(p_value, digits = 2))
  )
}))

cell_strip_palette <- c(
  Exc = "#16A249",
  Inh = "#79B85A",
  Ast = "#D9232B",
  Oli = "#F0A047",
  OPC = "#A85D3C",
  `Mic/Immune` = "#C4ADD3",
  Vasc = "#E5ADCA"
)

strip_data <- data.frame(
  cell_type = cell_types,
  x = seq_along(cell_types),
  xmin = seq_along(cell_types) - 0.47,
  xmax = seq_along(cell_types) + 0.47,
  ymin = 0.722,
  ymax = 0.752,
  strip_colour = unname(cell_strip_palette[cell_types])
)

baseline_data <- data.frame(
  x = seq_along(cell_types),
  xend = seq_along(cell_types),
  xmin = seq_along(cell_types) - 0.43,
  xmax = seq_along(cell_types) + 0.43,
  y = 0.35
)
```

## 绘图

```{r split-violin-plot}
compartment_palette <- c(
  Active = "#E7A6C4",
  Repressive = "#0B4B96"
)

p <- ggplot(
  violin_data,
  aes(
    x = x,
    y = at_content,
    fill = compartment,
    group = split_group
  )
) +
  geom_split_violin(
    trim = FALSE,
    width = 0.82,
    colour = NA,
    alpha = 0.98
  ) +
  geom_linerange(
    data = summary_data,
    aes(x = x, ymin = q25, ymax = q75),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    colour = "white",
    linewidth = 1.05
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = summary_data,
    aes(x = x, y = median),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    shape = 21,
    size = 2.45,
    stroke = 0.35,
    fill = "white",
    colour = "white"
  ) +
  geom_segment(
    data = baseline_data,
    aes(x = xmin, xend = xmax, y = y, yend = y),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    colour = "black",
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_segment(
    data = significance_data,
    aes(x = x - 0.25, xend = x + 0.25, y = 0.695, yend = 0.695),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    linewidth = 0.48,
    colour = "black"
  ) +
  geom_segment(
    data = significance_data,
    aes(x = x - 0.25, xend = x - 0.25, y = 0.686, yend = 0.695),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    linewidth = 0.48,
    colour = "black"
  ) +
  geom_segment(
    data = significance_data,
    aes(x = x + 0.25, xend = x + 0.25, y = 0.686, yend = 0.695),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    linewidth = 0.48,
    colour = "black"
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = significance_data,
    aes(x = x, y = 0.704, label = label),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 2.7,
    colour = "black"
  ) +
  geom_rect(
    data = strip_data,
    aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    fill = strip_data$strip_colour,
    colour = "white",
    linewidth = 0.65
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = strip_data,
    aes(x = x, y = (ymin + ymax) / 2, label = cell_type),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 3.25,
    lineheight = 0.75,
    colour = "#222222"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = compartment_palette,
    name = "Epigenomic\ncompartment"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(0.50, 7.50),
    breaks = seq_along(cell_types),
    labels = rep("", length(cell_types)),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0.35, 0.755),
    breaks = seq(0.4, 0.7, by = 0.1),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "A/T content",
    caption = "Synthetic demonstration · reproducible seed: 1031"
  ) +
  guides(
    fill = guide_legend(
      override.aes = list(colour = NA),
      keyheight = grid::unit(5.2, "mm"),
      keywidth = grid::unit(5.2, "mm")
    )
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.line.x = element_blank(),
    axis.line.y = element_line(linewidth = 0.65),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_text(colour = "#222222"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(face = "bold", margin = margin(r = 8)),
    legend.position = "inside",
    legend.position.inside = c(0.79, 0.20),
    legend.justification = c(0, 0),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10.5, lineheight = 0.88),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.background = element_rect(
      fill = scales::alpha("white", 0.88),
      colour = NA
    ),
    plot.caption = element_text(colour = "#6A7073", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.margin = margin(12, 14, 10, 12)
  )

p

ggsave(
  "split_violin_plot.png",
  p,
  width = 10,
  height = 6.8,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 320,
  bg = "white"
)
```

## 输出文件

- `split_violin_plot.html`：自包含 R Markdown 编译结果；
- `split_violin_plot.png`：320 dpi 高清图；
- `synthetic_at_content.csv`：模拟 A/T content 数据；
- `significance_results.csv`：七类细胞的显著性检验结果。

```{r save-significance-results, include=FALSE}
write.csv(
  significance_data,
  "significance_results.csv",
  row.names = FALSE,
  fileEncoding = "UTF-8"
)
```
